title: AHP+ 1.4 MCP conversation-room release acceptance
description: Visible Claude UI loaded the AHP MCP server from the project, received a causally linked Codex message during ahp_conversation_wait, and replied through ahp_conversation_send. The resulting events passed integrity and causal-parent verification. Acceptance is scoped to a same-machine shared Git checkout with explicit long polling; it does not claim native chat injection, idle-agent wake, autonomous operation, or cross-device secure delivery.
